newsitem.title: USA: Stratosphere says bankruptcy filing likely.
newsitem.headline: Stratosphere says bankruptcy filing likely.

text.p: Stratosphere Corp, which did not make a $14.5 million interest payment on its mortgage notes due on November 15, said Tuesday it may file bankruptcy.
The hotel and casino has 30 days before being in default of the notes, but said it did not expect to make such a payment.
Stratosphere said it continues to seek additional financing and is discussing restructuring its mortgage notes debt.
Stratosphere said it is "highly likely" that talks with creditors will involve a bankruptcy filing as a means of formalizing either a consensual or nonconsensual restructuring plan.
The company said it did not expect a bankruptcy filing would adversely affect daily operations or guest services.
Grand Casinos Inc owns 42 percent of Stratosphere.
Stratosphere's casino and hotel property opened in April. The company in August suspended contruction of an additional hotel tower, citing a cash shortfall.
